signals.name: versionId
signals.description: Specification version identifier for tracking in Power BI projects

signals.name: defaultCollapseDepth
signals.description: Initial collapse level: 1 collapses managers at Level 1 and below (shows Level 0 and 1 on load). Set to 2 to show through Level 2, or 99 to expand all.

signals.name: enableStacking
signals.description: Layout mode: true stacks large individual-contributor teams (> gridThreshold reports, no managers among them) into 2 vertical columns connected to their manager by a central spine; false renders the standard tree with all direct reports on one horizontal bus line.

signals.name: gridThreshold
signals.description: Direct report threshold for 2-column stacking: a team stacks only if it has more reports than this AND none of those reports manage anyone (mixed teams stay horizontal so peers never share a row with a colleague's reports).

signals.name: stackMinDepth
signals.description: Minimum hierarchy level depth where multi-column grid stacking is permitted (default: 2 prevents CEO / Level 1 executive team from stacking vertically)

signals.name: cardWidth
signals.description: Width of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: cardHeight
signals.description: Height of each employee card in pixels

signals.name: nodeSpacingX
signals.description: Horizontal distance between sibling node centers

signals.name: nodeSpacingY
signals.description: Vertical distance between hierarchy level centers (spacious corridor for clean branch routing)

signals.name: topMargin
signals.description: Top margin offset reserving space for the top control bar

signals.name: minCanvasWidth
signals.description: Fixed canvas width in pixels (keeps toolbar centered while panning/zooming)

signals.name: toolbarOriginX
signals.description: Horizontal origin of the floating toolbar so it stays centered above the CEO / tree

signals.name: expandAllOverride
signals.description: Global flag set to true when Expand All is clicked, false on Collapse All

signals.name: expandedIds
